senses.gloss: f. (v. אַחֲרָאִי) surety, esp. mortgaged property, or property which may be resorted to in case of non-payment (even if sold).—נכסים שיש להן א׳ property from which debts may eventually be collected (landed property), נ׳ שאין להם א׳ property which cannot be resorted to (movable property).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 3:11">B. Mets. III, 11</cite> <he>חייב באחריותן</he> is responsible for them (if lost).
<cite ref="Menachot 109a:8">Men. 109ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.—<he>א׳ נכסים</he> an obligation for which property is pledged.
<cite ref="Ketubot 51b:5">Ib. 51ᵇ</cite>, a. e. documents <he>שאין בהן א׳ נ׳</he> in which the clause pledging property is omitted.
<cite ref="Ketubot 51a:14">Ib. 51ᵃ</cite>; a. e. <he>א׳ טעות סופר הוא</he> the omission of the clause pledging property is considered as the scribe’s mistake (hence has no legal consequences).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 14a:9">B. Mets. 14ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>ראובן שמכר … בא׳</he> if R. sold to S. a field with surety (guaranteeing the title).
